# Security policy

## Supported version

Only the current default branch is maintained. Dated experiment runners are
research provenance and may require their recorded environments.

## Reporting a vulnerability or accidental disclosure

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting for this repository. Do not place
credentials, raw customer text, private annotations or exploit details in a
public issue.

If a credential appears in Git history, revoke or rotate it before attempting
repository cleanup. A normal deletion does not remove earlier Git objects.

The repository intentionally distributes aggregate research evidence rather
than raw reviews, model weights or row-level official-test outputs. Please also
report any accidental violation of that boundary privately.
